questions.stem: Per this page, what does a "reason to change" in SRP correspond to?

options.text: A stakeholder or business concern that the class serves
options.says: The page says a reason to change maps to a stakeholder or business concern.

options.text: A single operation that the class exposes as its one method
options.says: The page says SRP is about reasons to change, not doing one thing, and a class may have many methods.

options.text: A size limit that the class keeps so it stays short to read
options.says: The page warns against splitting purely for the sake of having small classes.

questions.stem: Per this page, what is gained by keeping a thread-safe counter apart from the code that formats its value for display?

options.text: The formatting code needs no synchronization of its own
options.says: The page says the formatter then needs no synchronization at all.

options.text: The counting code needs no atomic variable of its own
options.says: The page's counter keeps its count in an AtomicLong.

options.text: The two classes can share one lock to guard all state
options.says: The page says each class manages only its own locks, so unrelated concerns do not share one.
